import time


def test_a(clock):
    start = time.monotonic()
    work()
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - start
    assert elapsed < 2.0  # jigane: allow-flaky FLK-WALL-CLOCK -- 期待 0.5 秒に 4 倍の余裕
    assert elapsed > 0.0
    assert elapsed < limit


def test_b():

def test_c():
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    work()
    # jigane: allow-flaky FLK-WALL-CLOCK -- 期待 10 ms の 5 倍を上限にする
    assert time.perf_counter() - t0 < 0.05
